decisions.reason: The check-in app was featured on the home page and built with in-house technology, and its weak results can still be blamed on the temporary COVID collapse in air travel, so management would rather persist than write it off.

PassBoard had a formal public launch announcement and is central to the firm's stated innovation-led leadership strategy, so dropping it would expose the earlier decision as a mistake while the pandemic offers a temporary explanation for poor uptake.

The self-service check-in solution was visibly promoted, fits the post-pandemic demand for contactless processing, and its disappointing results can be attributed to the aviation downturn rather than the product itself.
